citations.quote: Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 54, requiring all packaging in the state to be recyclable or compostable by 2032, cutting plastic packaging by 25 percent in 10 years and requiring 65 percent of all single-use plastic packaging to be recycled in the same timeframe.

title.value: Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act

citations.quote: Initially introduced in December 2018, the Plastic Pollution Prevention and Packaging Producer Responsibility Act is the result of four years of negotiation amongst dozens of business and industry representatives, environmental organizations, subject-matter experts, and government leaders.
